textTemplates.name: SVC_AdviseCustomerMore40Days_Action_TextTemplate
textTemplates.text: Inform the customer on the relevant next actions related to their debit order reversal.

textTemplates.name: SVC_AdviseCustomerMore40Days_Script_TextTemplate
textTemplates.text: {!SVC_RetrieveContactFromDeployedRecordId.FirstName} please note that you can stop a debit order from the date on which we process your request, provided that the debit order details stay the same. We can't guarantee that the debit order will be stopped if there are any changes to the amount or reference. Please ensure that you request for us to stop a debit order at least one business day before the bank processes the payment - business days Monday to Saturdays, excluding public holidays.

textTemplates.name: SVC_AdviseCustomerOfDisclaimerActionTextTemplate
textTemplates.text: Inform the customer that they are responsible for providing accurate data.

textTemplates.name: SVC_AdviseCustomerOfDisclaimerScriptTextTemplate
textTemplates.text: {!SVC_RetrieveContactFromDeployedRecordId.FirstName}, please note that Standard Bank will take the information you have provided as accurate. Standard Bank will not be held liable for any errors or omissions in the information provided. Would you agree to this before we progress with your request?

textTemplates.name: SVC_AdviseCustomerOfDisclaimerText
textTemplates.text: Advise Customer of Disclaimer

textTemplates.name: SVC_AdviseCustomerOnNextStepsActionTextTemplate
textTemplates.text: Inform the customer on the relevant next actions related to their debit order reversal.

textTemplates.name: SVC_AdviseCustomerOnNextStepsScriptTextTemplate
textTemplates.text: Your Debit Order has been reversed. Please note that it may take up to 24 hours for the funds to reflect in your account. You can stop a debit order from the date on which we process your request, provided that the debit order details stay the same. We can’t guarantee that the debit order will be stopped if there are any changes to the amount or reference. Please ensure that you request for us to stop a debit order at least one business day before the bank processes the payment - business days are Monday to Saturdays, excluding public holidays.

textTemplates.name: SVC_AdviseCustomerOnNextStepsText
textTemplates.text: Advise Customer On Next Steps

textTemplates.name: SVC_AdviseCustomerOnSelfServiceActionTextTemplate
textTemplates.text: Inform the customer that this request can be dealt on a self-service digital platform.

textTemplates.name: SVC_AdviseCustomerOnSelfServiceScriptTextTemplate
textTemplates.text: {!SVC_RetrieveContactFromDeployedRecordId.FirstName}, please note that you can reverse debit orders up to R200 that went off your account in the last 40 days on our mobile App at a cost of R2. If you have the App - Please go to manage select debit orders and click the reverse debit order option then select the account, as well as the debit order that needs to be reversed and then select reverse. If you so not have the app - May I please ask, {!SVC_RetrieveContactFromDeployedRecordId.FirstName}, which device do you use and may I guide you on how to download the App either from the Play Store or Huawei APP Gallery?

textTemplates.name: SVC_InformCustomerOfAdditionalFeeActionTextTemplate
textTemplates.text: Inform the customer about the applicable fee and the turn around time for the request.

textTemplates.name: SVC_InformCustomerOfAdditionalFeeScriptTextTemplate
textTemplates.text: {!SVC_RetrieveContactFromDeployedRecordId.FirstName}, because your debit order went off over 40 days ago, there will be an additional fee of R350 to reverse this debit order and the turn around time for this request can take up to 45 days. Please note if the disputed debit relates to a debit order you know about, we recommend that you advise the beneficiary of this dispute if you have not already done so. If you don't want this debit order to be debited to your account in the future, please complete a Stop Payment Notice 00029078. Requests for reversal received after 40 days from the date the account was debited will only be granted if the beneficiary fails to prove authority to debit. Please note that you may be charged an administration fee for resolving this dispute. Please note that should the dispute be unsuccessful, you will be charged a handling fee according to the Bank's pricing structure.
